name: Dictators of the Twentieth Century
description: Strongmen and one-party rulers who held absolute power across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas, and the wars and fall of their regimes.

checkpoints.name: Revolution and fascism
checkpoints.note: Lenin founds the Soviet state, Stalin takes it over, Mussolini invents fascism in Italy and Hitler takes power in Germany.

checkpoints.name: War and its aftermath
checkpoints.note: Hitler and Mussolini lead Europe into war, Franco wins in Spain, Chiang fights Japan, and the war ends with Soviet and Allied victory and the death of Stalin.

checkpoints.name: Cold War strongmen
checkpoints.note: Mao, Tito, Kim Il Sung, Peron and Salazar rule in the shadow of the superpowers, and Pinochet, Marcos, Suharto and Idi Amin take power in coups.

checkpoints.name: The last regimes
checkpoints.note: Communist rulers fall in Eastern Europe in 1989, Pol Pot and Mobutu are ousted, and Khomeini, Saddam Hussein and Gaddafi mark the final years of the century and after.
